profile.about: I'm an AI Automation Engineer & Full Stack Developer building autonomous agent systems and modern web products. I design end-to-end solutions—from clean, responsive frontends to secure APIs and production deployments—focused on reliability, performance, and real business outcomes. My work spans agentic workflows (tool use, planning/execution loops, RAG, vector search), automation pipelines, and cloud-native app delivery with strong engineering practices. Based in Karachi, Pakistan.
